map.：RH<30% 干（咽干静电）、>70% 潮（霉闷），40%–60% 最舒适，加: : RH below 30% is dry (dry throat, static electricity), above 70% is damp (musty and stuffy), and 40%-60% is most comfortable, so target that range when humidifying or dehumidifying.
map.相对湿度一天怎么变？: How does relative humidity change over a day?
map.水汽量相对稳时，升温 RH 降、降温 RH 升，所以清晨 RH 最高、午后最低。: When the amount of water vapour is relatively stable, warming lowers RH and cooling raises it, so RH is highest in the early morning and lowest in the afternoon.
map.多为温漂与滞后，定期用盐饱和溶液校准，避免长期偏差。: Mostly temperature drift and hysteresis; calibrate regularly with a saturated salt solution to avoid long-term bias.
